authority: Framework operational evidence map derived from exact Assessment Plans and canonical Mastery Goals.
question_structure_rule: All authored Exit questions must use the current universal Question Structure authority. This map owns evidence allocation, not structure IDs or final prompt wording.
normal_ticket_rule: One official four-question Exit Ticket per section: Q1-Q2 are two new current-Mastery evidence jobs; Q3-Q4 are fresh parallel reassessments of the previous section carryforward pair.
parallel_rule: Parallel reassessment preserves the evidence target and usable difficulty while varying allowed values, representation, context, or structure. It is not an automatic literal clone.
u1_1_rule: U1.1 has four opening readiness/mastery questions from U1-MG01. Q1-Q2 form the carryforward pair repeated in U1.2; Q3-Q4 are additional opening evidence and do not create fake prior-section repeats.
terminal_rule: U8.5 has no later Algebra Exit Ticket. Its new evidence is carried into the Unit 8 Summative evidence plan rather than inventing a nonexistent next Algebra section.
